title: Uniform block moment interpolation for positive real spectra with weak-gap parameter at most one and canonical separated grouping
author: Assia Benabdallah; Franck Boyer; Morgan Morancey
work: A block moment method to handle spectral condensation phenomenon in parabolic control problems
source_version: Annales Henri Lebesgue 3 (2020), publisher version, DOI 10.5802/ahl.45
difficulty_reason: The authored construction uses Blaschke products and Newton interpolation in Hardy space, proves uniform inverse-restriction estimates by normal-family compactness, and controls inverse-product derivatives to resolve clustered exponential moments. This is research-level spectral interpolation rather than an ordinary qualifying argument.

The complete author body retains all Hardy/Blaschke/Newton interpolation, finite-time inverse-restriction, inverse-product derivative and canonical-grouping arguments.
